title: 6. ПЕТРУНИНО ХОРО 1/ Petrunino horo 1- урок  по народни танци за 9мин
channel: Bulgarian folk dancing  tutorial with Petya

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor explains the rhythm and tempo of the dance before demonstrating each measure step by step. She uses counting and verbal explanation while breaking down the steps in place.

lesson_structure.note: Demonstration of Petrunino horo in traditional costume
Greeting and introduction of the dance from Shopska region
Step by step breakdown of the dance measures

steps_taught.name: Първи и втори такт
steps_taught.description: Three steps or a slight hop on three times followed by two steps

steps_taught.name: Трети и четвърти такт
steps_taught.description: Cosička s podskok and four ordinary steps

steps_taught.name: Пети такт
steps_taught.description: Crossing steps to the left with left in front

steps_taught.name: Шести такт
steps_taught.description: Podskok s slivka and left/right variations

steps_taught.name: Седми и осми такт
steps_taught.description: Rytnik variations starting left or right

what_works: Clear counting of measures and breakdown of individual parts
what_hinders: No music during the breakdown phase

quotes.text: Хорото е в такт и размер 12 шестнайсти

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands outdoors in athletic wear talking to the camera to introduce the dance.
Teacher demonstrates footwork counts while standing sideways in profile view.

extraction.distinctive_method: Verbal explanation of the regional style characteristics (Shopski horo) and detailed counting of 12/16 meter as 5 beats per measure.
